verdict.rationale: The only CLI evidence is one marketing line saying Zia Agent Studio 'also works via CLI with Cursor, VS Code, Claude Code, and more.' That line could just as well describe third-party AI tools' CLIs reaching Zoho through its MCP server, rather than a first-party Zoho CLI. The Python and Node SDKs, REST APIs and MCP server are developer building blocks or adjacent features and earn no credit toward an official CLI. Missing for 10: a documented, named official Zoho CRM CLI tool, its install and command reference, coverage of CRM operations from the terminal, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
